game_title: Range Runner – Fairy Ring Glade Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Fairy Ring Glade, a glade ringed by mushrooms: the herbalist must handle bog toads while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Range Runner: Run a for i in range(n) loop so the herbalist moves exactly n steps toward the fairy lantern.
theme: Mystic Forest – Fairy Ring Glade: a glade ringed by mushrooms
core_gameplay_loop: In Fairy Ring Glade, repeat each round: Run a for i in range(n) loop so the herbalist moves exactly n steps toward the fairy lantern. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the steps_left value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the fairy lantern using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The fairy lantern reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the fairy lantern is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Range Runner
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Range Runner' (Week 5 slot 1), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Fairy Ring Glade'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how steps_left changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bog toads in Fairy Ring Glade.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The fairy lantern reached with actions_used <= 19.
